verdicts.quote: when a spot opens, the first eligible waitlisted member is booked immediately, no offer to accept.

the list is ordered by acceptance order (I-4). … simultaneous joins, leaves, bookings and cancellations resolve as if executed in some serial order … **Left out:** priority tiers, manual reordering (G-2).
Waitlisting overlapping classes is allowed. … Eligibility rules at join and at promotion (active membership, credits, overlapping booking) and their charge timing.
verdicts.missing: Whether booking the first class removes the overlapping entry immediately, leaves it for a later eligibility check, or permits both bookings.

verdicts.quote: a member may be booked into a class they no longer want and must cancel under the normal cancellation rules.
verdicts.missing: Whether declining late or missing an automatically booked class incurs the usual late-cancellation or no-show penalty.

verdicts.quote: a cancellation that frees a spot and the promotion of the first eligible waitlist entry commit as one unit in the same authoritative store that holds bookings. … the waiting member finds themselves booked, without acting.
A notification is attempted through the channel chosen under G-3 stating class, date and time. … a delivery failure never undoes the booking and is recorded
verdicts.missing: Which channel delivers the promotion notice.

verdicts.quote: k spots promote the first k eligible entries in order. … No member is promoted twice and no spot is double-assigned. … The booked count of a class never exceeds its capacity because of any booking or promotion.

simultaneous joins, leaves, bookings and cancellations resolve as if executed in some serial order … direct book | not booked to booked if free | `CLASS_FULL` offers waitlist; `ALREADY_BOOKED`; `ALREADY_WAITLISTED`
Joining the waitlist costs nothing and holds no credit or payment; any charge happens only at promotion, exactly as a normal booking would.
verdicts.missing: If the charge fails, whether the member keeps their place and whether the spot passes to the next member.

verdicts.quote: Waitlist cap (per class, per member) unspecified. No bound is invented. … Treated as unbounded in the spec; capacity planning unready.
verdicts.missing: The default is unlimited. If a cap is adopted, its value and the response shown when the list is full are unspecified.

verdicts.quote: The waitlist closes at class start. Promotion happens up to class start; no earlier cutoff.
capacity 3 raised to 5, booked A, B, C, waitlist D, E, F, G: D and E are promoted, waitlist F, G, booked 5
verdicts.missing: Whether staff may lower capacity while members are waiting and what happens to bookings and the queue if capacity falls below the booked count.

verdicts.quote: If the class is cancelled (existing staff action, G-7), all entries are removed and members notified together with booked members as today.
Waitlist entry (class, member, join order, status) … Waitlist order is first come, first served by the time the join was accepted.
verdicts.missing: Whether the record retains the acceptance timestamp as well as join order, and whether the authority persists current position or computes it from the surviving entries.

verdicts.quote: at class start the waitlist is closed and its entries removed
A member can read their own position at any time. … Others' identities and the list length are not exposed (R-8).

**Left out:** staff views (G-8). … **Left out:** bulk removal, staff removal (G-8). … The authority records events with class id, member id, reason and order: `waitlist.joined`, `waitlist.left`, `waitlist.promoted`
verdicts.missing: Staff roster access and manual management are excluded. The spec gives staff no way to promote someone or see who was promoted at what time.

verdicts.quote: a cancellation that frees a spot and the promotion of the first eligible waitlist entry commit as one unit in the same authoritative store that holds bookings.
booking a class with a free spot, cancelling a booking, listing classes and the capacity limit work as they do today. … no existing record is migrated.
on a full class the primary action reads "Join waitlist" (replacing a disabled "Class full"). … created on join … Migration: waitlist entries are a new record; no existing record is migrated.
